name: Ferienhütte Schneeberg
beschreibung:
Perched on a sunny forest clearing above the Thiersee valley, the rustic Ferienhuette Schneeberg provides the perfect mountain hideaway for families, groups, and hikers. Crafted with traditional timber features and modern self-catering facilities, it guarantees peaceful days close to nature.

Scenic hiking paths begin right at the front door, while Lake Thiersee and the town of Kufstein are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienhuette Schneeberg in Thiersee offers rustic alpine cabin charm in a sunny secluded setting in Kufsteinerland.
